title: Toggle: Using the attributeName in the template

comments.body:
There's multiple workarounds at least for this case:

1. wrap the input in the label and you don't need the brittle coupling of ids, which is more accessible
2. use `transformData` as you said
3. we add `attributeName` to all of the templates

I can see why you'd want this, but we haven't had any problems so far with this, so I'm not sure yet if it should be added.

If you have a lot of toggles, is it possible you really want a custom [refinementList](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/widgets/refinementList.html) instead? That would be simpler I think. You can customise the rendering completely by using the connector if necessary
Feel free to reopen this issue if you find a need for it again though, I'm totally open for the idea, just looking for usecases
@Haroenv Yes I feel a unique identifier that could be passed to the template would be nice to have, as for use cases outside what I've explained I can't think of any
I'll leave this open for now because I can see the value

Hi @Braunson 
I'd like to be sure to understand your need here: do you want a unique identifier of the widget items that is also usable in your template for markup identifier (and it should not contain any spaces or special characters)? This identifier should be provided as part of the values provided to the values?
@bobylito Yep exactly, I was thinking of using the `attributeName` but having a unique one that could be set would work also.
I've added the feedback to put the product team in the loop. I'm closing the issue for now.
